analysis.reasonEn: RSI has moved out of oversold territory (32.1), but the MACD histogram is worsening and continues to decline in negative territory (-9.3541). The volume ratio (0.67) is subdued, and the current price ($154.60) is trading below the SMA200 ($185.36) by -16.59%, continuing the downtrend. The weekly ADX (29.6) indicates a strong trend, but the -DI (43.0) is above the +DI (16.4), showing strong downward pressure. Caution is advised near the swing support level ($146.85).
